{"content":"import os
import re


class SQLSanitizer:
    def __init__(self, file_path):
        self.file_path = file_path

    def validate_file(self):
        if not os.path.isfile(self.file_path) or not os.access(self.file_path, os.R_OK):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"File not found or not readable: {self.file_path}")

    def sanitize_content(self, content):
        if not content:
            return content
        cleaned = content
        # 1. Union-Based Injection: UNION SELECT / UNION ALL SELECT (case-insensitive)
        cleaned = re.sub(
            r"\bUNION\s+(ALL\s+)?SELECT\b",
            "",
            cleaned,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
        )
        # 2. DDL Sabotage: DROP TABLE / DROP DATABASE (case-insensitive)
        cleaned = re.sub(
            r"\bDROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE)\b",
            "",
            cleaned,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
        )
        # 3. Tautologies: OR 'x'='x' / OR "x"="x" / OR x=x (case-insensitive OR,
        #    both sides must be equal so legitimate OR conditions are preserved)
        cleaned = re.sub(
            r"\bOR\b\s*(['\"]?)(\w+)\1\s*=\s*(['\"]?)\2\3",
            "",
            cleaned,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
        )
        # 4. Comment Injection: remove --... or #... only if followed by text
        #    on the same line; preserve newlines and lone markers.
        cleaned = re.sub(r"--[ \t]*\S[^\n]*", "", cleaned)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"#[ \t]*\S[^\n]*", "", cleaned)
        return cleaned

    def process(self):
        self.validate_file()
        with open(self.file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            content = f.read()
        cleaned = self.sanitize_content(content)
        with open(self.file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(cleaned)
